changes: Added provider-free Cell03 shard tooling under experiments/multi-model-ablation/cell03-shards/: plan.mjs (deterministic 1152-key shard partition + envelope digest binding), shard-runner.mjs (shard-local fixture output with mkdir lock; overwrite refusal now inside the lock), merge.mjs (validator rejecting duplicate/missing/shard-count/wrong-shard rows and binding drift vs the live envelope, and refusing to write canonical cell03-rows.jsonl), selfcheck.mjs (10-marker fail-closed self-test), plus README boundary docs.
expectedOutcome: selfcheck prints a single PASS line with coverage=1152 shards=8 and every reject marker =pass, ending with canonicalUntouched=pass
actualTranscript: cell03-shards selfcheck PASS: coverage=1152 shards=8 invalidIndexReject=pass lockReject=pass rerunReject=pass mergeComplete=pass duplicateReject=pass missingReject=pass digestDriftReject=pass envelopeBindingReject=pass canonicalWriteRefused=pass canonicalUntouched=pass
outcomeDiff: No difference — actual selfcheck output matches the expected PASS line byte-for-byte.
limitations: Provider-free tool layer only. Does NOT integrate the real B-991d provider runner, per-attempt attemptId/runId/usage accounting, retry/superseded de-duplication, cumulative-token protection, or a formal result-writer — all deferred to successor story B-fd23 (documented in cell03-shards/README.md).
pitfalls: Round-1 review found 5 real defects: F-001 TOCTOU overwrite race (overwrite check was outside the shard lock) and F-004 merge binding checked peer manifests not the live envelope (so consistently-forged shards merged), plus 3 coverage gaps. All fixed in bca25a5e9, re-verified in round 2 and by a genuine Codex host-B cross-vendor quorum. Next person: merge binding must anchor to envelope-derived plan.binding not manifests[0], and the overwrite check must live inside the shard lock.
